name: Kyanite (iOS Metal Port)
description: Experimental iOS Metal renderer. Extracts sprite quads and atlas textures, then draws them through a Metal render pass using GPU-computed visibility; dynamic color/effect parity is incomplete.

enabled.name: Metal diagnostics enabled
enabled.description: Enable Kyanite's experimental Metal diagnostics. This does not replace Geometry Dash's level renderer yet.

diagnostics_overlay.name: Show Metal diagnostics overlay
diagnostics_overlay.description: Show live Metal device, compute self-test, and renderer fallback status while playing.

run_metal_probe.name: Run Metal GPU visibility workload
run_metal_probe.description: Submit a small one-time Metal compute dispatch to verify that the device, command queue, and compute pipeline work.
